description: The flagship path on real captured data, scored honestly per order per step: one host capture cycle (the case.po_document_chain host config: the Portal purchase orders, Business Central purchase orders and lines, the purchase-order mailbox and SharePoint, all read-only), then offline over those captures scripts/eval_flagship_path.py picks up to 3 orders from the lateness model (evals/oracle/po_lateness.py over the raw captured Portal and BC rows, never through the product: open PO lines past their governing date, FileMaker then Portal then BC) and runs six steps on each: home (recall: the late orders the home lists out of the late orders the model finds), ask (the console's Ask agent; correct = it cites every late line of one system and names each governing date in a claim citing the record the date is read from, and cites a BC record plus a firm second source, a captured mail or SharePoint document whose raw text names the PO number exactly; a BC<->Portal number twin or an unconfirmed document is a lead and must be worded as one), timing (an Ask over 20 s fails), landed_cost (passes only with a number, an estimate labelled), draft (a follow-up recorded on the case, cited, never approved, executed or sent) and margin (the customer order this PO feeds; with no purchase-order to sales-order link it reads unrelated_sample, never a pass). Once per run a sales-order margin sample through the same workspace reads unrelated_sample with its verdict. Red is expected where the product is not ready; the check asserts the honest scoring ran, not that the product passes. Counts and enums only, never an identifier or value.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; the script's tests are isolated-fixture / injected-transport (operator_ui/tests/test_flagship_path.py: every step over the case_fixtures world with a scripted Ask planner and the lateness oracle over its Portal mirror rows; recall 0, the wrong-date two-system answer, the gaps-only landed cost, the unrelated margin sample and the 25 s Ask over stub workspaces; operator_ui/tests/test_flagship_margin.py: the margin verdict over the real plx.investigate for a full and a finance-withheld reader). No --identify: no order number, object id, claim, citation, date or draft text reaches the output. Nothing is written to a source system and nothing is sent. Expected red today: no schema link joins a purchase order to the sales order it feeds, so the margin step reads unrelated_sample on every order (passed.margin 0); the Ask fails with the first rule it breaks (late_lines_not_cited, governing_date_not_named, no_bc_record_cited, no_second_source_cited, lead_not_worded_as_lead, ask_over_20_seconds on timing); a late order the product does not hold fails every step as order_not_held. oracle.unread names what the reader could not read (a missing BC capture, an ungranted relation or BC unit); the oracle sees only what the principal may read, and Sage is not read. Without a planner credential the ask step reads blocked naming PLX_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (requires_env_any makes the check skipped first).
